item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 10/Dec/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the easterly airstream moderating, it will be warm during the day over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. A surge of northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of southern China midweek this week. It will be brighter over the region in the latter part of this week. Another intense northeast monsoon will reach southern China next weekend. Temperatures will fall appreciably and it will become cool over the region.

Date/Month: 10/12 (Sunday)

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night. Bright periods during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
